title: Sequential smFISH Protocol
author: ZengU19 BICCN Grant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y6nfzde
materials: Pre-heat hyb oven to 37 °C Undetermined, oven
GLOX buffer step if performing antibody stain

steps.title: Prepare cryosections
steps.instruction: Collect 10-14 um cryosections from fresh-frozen tissue on poly-lysine-treated #1 coverslips at room temperature (RT).

substeps.instruction: Allow sections to sit at RT for 5-10 min.
Place sections at 4°C until sectioning is complete.

steps.title: Fix sections
steps.instruction: Post-fix sections for 15 min with 4% PFA at 4°C.

steps.title: Permeabilize sections
steps.instruction: Permeabilize sections with cold methanol at -20°C for 10 min.

steps.title: Air dry sections
steps.instruction: Air dry for 30 min in a fume hood. (Optional stopping point: store coverslips at -80°C).

steps.title: Optional SDS treatment
steps.instruction: Treat sections with 8% SDS/PBS for 10 minutes, followed by 3–5 rinses with PBS or 2XSSC.

steps.title: Prepare for hybridization
steps.instruction: Add 2ml 2X SSC to the sections and place sections in hybridization buffer without probes.

steps.title: Hybridize probes
steps.instruction: Add 4 ul probe to 400ul hybridization buffer (note: volume can be reduced if using a perfusion chamber instead of a 6-well plate) and incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Perform stringency washes
steps.instruction: Wash sections at 37°C using wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml wash buffer to each well and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 2 ml fresh wash buffer and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.

steps.title: Counterstain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Replace wash buffer with fresh wash buffer containing DAPI (final concentration 5ug/mL) and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.

steps.title: Mount and image
steps.instruction: Mount and image the sections, or store at 4°C in 2XSSC until the imaging session.

steps.title: Strip probes for sequential rounds
steps.instruction: Remove probes to allow for subsequent hybridization rounds.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 65% formamide/2X SSC for 10 min, repeated 3 times (10 min x 3) at 30°C.
